1. Scope of Work
    The project scope is defined in the proposed service items. Any additional features will be billed separately.
  2. Project Timeline
    The timeline commences upon receipt of the advance payment and all required resources from the client.
  3. Payment Terms
    Payments are to be made according to the payment plan attached. Late payments may incur a penalty.
  4. Refund & Cancellation
    Advance payments are non-refundable once work has commenced.
  5. Client Responsibilities
    The client must provide necessary content, branding guidelines, and timely feedback.
  6. Revisions
    The quote includes up to 2 rounds of minor revisions per design phase. Major layout changes will be charged extra.
  7. IP Rights
    Upon full payment, the intellectual property rights of the custom code and design are transferred to the client.
  8. Third-Party Services
    Costs for third-party tools, plugins, or stock images are not included unless specified.
  9. Maintenance & Support
    A 30-day bug-fixing warranty is provided post-launch. Extended maintenance requires an AMC.
  10. Limitation of Liability
    Xapp shall not be liable for indirect damages or loss of profits arising from the use of the delivered software.
  11. Confidentiality
    Both parties agree to keep all project details and proprietary information confidential.
  12. Termination
    Either party may terminate the agreement with a 15-day written notice. The client will be billed for work completed up to that date.
  13. Governing Law
    This agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.
  14. Acceptance
    Signing this quotation indicates acceptance of all terms and conditions.
